metronomeHelp: Play a click with the beat. Part volumes stay as set.
countInHelp: Count in for one measure in the destination time signature after seeking. Resuming or repeating a loop adds no count-in.
scaleDegreesHelp: Show scale degrees relative to the current key. Audio and mix stay as set. Choose all parts or one part.
